# SunRise PMC — Architectural Project Management Consultancy
> Western India's premier construction project management consultancy (PMC), turnkey development manager, and specialized Quantity Surveying (QS) billing audit authority.

## Overview
SunRise PMC is headquartered in Surat, Gujarat, India. Led by Managing Director Arjun Sharma (18+ years of engineering experience), SunRise PMC oversees multi-crore residential high-rises, commercial and diamond processing complexes, 5-star hospitality developments, and tertiary healthcare hospitals.

## Quick Facts
- Organization: SunRise PMC (SunRise Project Management Consultancy)
- Location: Surat, Gujarat, India (GL-2, Anand Avenue Commercial Complex, Ugat Junction, Bhesan Road, Surat 395005)
- Contact: +91 95860 00933 | contact@sunrisepmc.in
- Coordinates: 21.1983° N, 72.7844° E
- Managed Capital: ₹1,500+ Crore portfolio
- Projects Delivered: 20+ landmark developments

## Core Services
1. Turnkey Project Management (End-to-End Design to Handover, EPC oversight)
2. Quantity Surveying (QS) & Contractor Billing Audits (JMS, BOQ, forensic rate audits)
3. Project Planning & CPM Scheduling (Critical Path Method, delay mitigation)
4. Cost Management & Budget Control (Value engineering, cash flow forecasting)
5. Design Coordination & BIM (Clash detection across architectural, structural, and MEP)
6. Construction & Resident Site Management (Full-time site engineering supervision)
7. Quality Assurance (QA/QC) (Independent lab testing, stage pour sign-offs, zero-defect snagging)
8. Safety & Risk Management (EHS audits, hazard identification)
9. Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) (Post-occupancy building health)
10. Contractor Tender & Procurement Governance
